focus: Dropout: explain how each hidden unit is kept with probability p during training and how the outgoing weights are scaled by p at test time so the expected input to the next layer matches. Let the learner change the keep probability and a small vector of activations and weights. Show a sampled dropout mask, the training-time input, its expected value, and the test-time scaled input. Guide them through p = 1 (no dropout) and a small p. Check that the expected training-time input equals the test-time scaled input.
audience: Engineering undergraduate who has trained a small neural network but has not used regularization.
